<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_communities.addToUpdateSetUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Version 3.0
Utility script to add components to update sets</description><name>addToUpdateSetUtils</name><script><![CDATA[var addToUpdateSetUtils = Class.create();
addToUpdateSetUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },
	
	checkTable: function(tableRec, tableName) {
		/*
		 * Scoped addToUpdateSetUtils Script Includes are useful when table Application Access settings prevent other scopes from CRUD access.
		 * The global checkTable function is executed first and if no table match is found, then all scope checkTable functions are executed.
		 * If a table match is found within this script, set continueProcessing to false so no additional scope scripts are executed.
		 * If a scope table match is not found, then the single record will be added by the global checkTable function.
		 *
		 * If the table extends another table and you prefer to get all extensions, uncomment the default processParentTable = true and the if
		 * statement below it and set the table and function.
		 */
		
		var continueProcessing = true;
		var processParentTable = false;
		
		switch (tableName) {
			case "sn_communities_forum":
				this._addForum(tableRec, tableName);
				continueProcessing = false;
				break;
			case "sn_communities_permission":
				this._addPermission(tableRec, tableName);
				continueProcessing = false;
				break;
			case "sn_communities_profile":
				this._addCommunityProfileAndUser(tableRec, tableName);
				continueProcessing = false;
				break;
			default:
				//processParentTable = true;
				break;
		}

		/*if (processParentTable) {
			// Check for table needs at parent table level
			var tableBase = new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._getTableBase(tableName);
			switch (tableBase) {
				case "table_name":
					this._function_name(tableRec, tableName);
					continueProcessing = false;
					break;
			}
		}*/

		return continueProcessing;
	},
	
	_addForum: function(communityForum, tableName) {
		if (typeof communityForum == "string") {
			var recID = communityForum;
			communityForum = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_forum");
			communityForum.get(recID);
		}
		this._addToSet(communityForum);
		var forumID = communityForum.getValue("sys_id");
		this._gatherSubForums(forumID);

		var workflowID = communityForum.getValue("approval_workflow_for_membership");
		if (!gs.nil(workflowID)) {
			this._addWorkflow(workflowID);
		}

		this._addForumTopic(forumID);
		
		var contentTypeM2M = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_m2m_forum_contenttype");
		contentTypeM2M.addQuery("forum_id", forumID);
		contentTypeM2M.query();
		while (contentTypeM2M.next()) {
			this._addToSet(contentTypeM2M);
			this._addContentType(contentTypeM2M.getValue("content_type"));
			if (!gs.nil(contentTypeM2M.getValue("approval_workflow"))) {
				this._addWorkflow(contentTypeM2M.getValue("approval_workflow"));
			}
		}

		this._addForumPermissions(forumID);
		this._addForumContent(forumID);

		/* Not sure if we need this because it is tied to specific users, but leaving in just in case 
		   var permissionException = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_permission_exception");
		   permissionException.addQuery("forum", forumID);
		   permissionException.query();
		   while (permissionException.next()) {
			   this._addToSet(permissionException);
		   }
		*/
	},
	
	_gatherSubForums: function(forumID) {
		var communityForum = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_forum");
		communityForum.addQuery("parent", forumID);
		communityForum.query();
		while (communityForum.next()) {
			this._addForum(communityForum);
		}
	},
	
	_addForumTopic: function(forumID) {
		var forumTopicM2M = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_m2m_forum_topic");
		forumTopicM2M.addQuery("forum_id", forumID);
		forumTopicM2M.query();
		while (forumTopicM2M.next()) {
			this._addToSet(forumTopicM2M);
			
			var forumTopic = forumTopicM2M.topic_id.getRefRecord();
			this._addToSet(forumTopic);
		}
	},
	
	_addContentType: function(contentTypeID) {
		var contentType = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_content_type");
		if (contentType.get(contentTypeID)) {
			this._addToSet(contentType);

			var searchSource = contentType.getValue("sp_search_source");
			if (!gs.nil(searchSource)) {
				new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addSearchSources(searchSource);
			}
		}
	},
	
	_addForumPermissions: function(forumID) {
		var forumPermission = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_forum_permissions");
		forumPermission.addQuery("forum", forumID);
		forumPermission.query();
		while (forumPermission.next()) {
			this._addToSet(forumPermission);
			
			var forumUser = forumPermission.forum_user.getRefRecord();
			this._addToSet(forumUser);
			
			var forumMember = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_members");
			forumMember.addQuery("forum_user", forumUser.getValue("sys_id"));
			forumMember.query();
			while (forumMember.next()) {
				if (forumMember.getValue("membership_type") == "sys_user") {
					
				}
			}
			
			this._addPermission(forumPermission.getValue("permission"));
		}
	},
	
	_addPermission: function(permission, tableName) {
		if (typeof permission == "string") {
			var recID = permission;
			permission = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_permission");
			permission.get(recID);
		}
		this._addToSet(permission);

		var permissionDetail = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_permission_details");
		permissionDetail.addQuery("permission", permission.getValue("sys_id"));
		permissionDetail.query();
		while (permissionDetail.next()) {
			this._addToSet(permissionDetail);

			var accessType = permissionDetail.access.getRefRecord();
			this._addToSet(accessType);

			this._addContentType(permissionDetail.getValue("content_type"));
		}
	},
	
	_addForumContent: function(forumID) {
		var content = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_content");
		content.addQuery("forum_id", forumID);
		content.query();
		while (content.next()) {
			this._addToSet(content);
			this._addForumUser(content.profile.document.toString());
			
			var contentTable = content.getValue("content_name");
			var contentRec = new GlideRecord(contentTable);
			if (contentRec.get(content.getValue("content_id"))) {
				this._addToSet(contentRec);
				
				switch (contentTable) {
					case "sn_communities_video_as_content":
						var videoRec = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_video_library");
						if (videoRec.get(contentRec.getValue("video"))) {
							this._addToSet(videoRec);
						}
						break;
					case "sn_communities_event":
						var eventRSVP = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_event_rsvp");
						eventRSVP.addQuery("event", contentRec.getValue("sys_id"));
						eventRSVP.query();
						while (eventRSVP.next()) {
							this._addToSet(eventRSVP);
							this._addForumUser(eventRSVP.attendee.document.toString());
						}
						break;
				}
			}
		}
	},
	
	_addForumUser: function(userID) {
		var userRec = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
		if (userRec.get(userID)) {
			new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addUser(userRec, "sys_user");
		}
	},

	_addCommunityProfileAndUser: function(communityProfile, tableName) {
		this._addToSet(communityProfile);
		this._addForumUser(communityProfile.live_profile.document.toString());
	},
	
	_addCommunityProfile: function(liveProfileID) {
		var communityProfile = new GlideRecord("sn_communities_profile");
		communityProfile.addQuery("live_profile", liveProfileID);
		communityProfile.query();
		if (communityProfile.next()) {
			this._addToSet(communityProfile);
		}
	},
	
	_addWorkflow: function(workflowID) {
		var workflow = new GlideRecord("wf_workflow");
		if (workflow.get(workflowID)) {
			new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addWorkflow(workflow);
		}
	},
	
	_addToSet: function(tableRec) {
		new global.addToUpdateSetUtils().saveRecord(tableRec);
	},

    type: 'addToUpdateSetUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2019-03-11 20:00:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>211e1b7e4f4c7b00d1676bd18110c719</sys_id><sys_mod_count>11</sys_mod_count><sys_name>addToUpdateSetUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Community" source="sn_communities">10809a9edb866200b1f6f78eaf961904</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Community">10809a9edb866200b1f6f78eaf961904</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_211e1b7e4f4c7b00d1676bd18110c719</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2019-10-17 17:53:37</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<script><![CDATA[var addToUpdateSetUtils = Class.create();

		 * The global checkTable function is executed first and if no table match is found, then all scope checkTable functions are executed.
		 * If a table match is found within this script, set continueProcessing to false so no additional scope scripts are executed.
		 * If a scope table match is not found, then the single record will be added by the global checkTable function.
		 *
		 * If the table extends another table and you prefer to get all extensions, uncomment the default processParentTable = true and the if
		 * statement below it and set the table and function.
		 */
		
		var continueProcessing = true;
		var processParentTable = false;
		
		switch (tableName) {
			case "sn_hr_ef_document_type":
				this._addDocumentType(tableRec, tableName);

			// Check for table needs at parent table level

			}

		return continueProcessing;
	},
	
	_addDocumentType: function(documentType, tableName) {

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_cd.addToUpdateSetUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Version 3.1
Utility script to add components to update sets</description><name>addToUpdateSetUtils</name><script><![CDATA[var addToUpdateSetUtils = Class.create();
addToUpdateSetUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },
	
	checkTable: function(tableRec, tableName) {
		/*
		 * Scoped addToUpdateSetUtils Script Includes are useful when table Application Access settings prevent other scopes from CRUD access.
		 * The global checkTable function is executed first and if no table match is found, then all scope checkTable functions are executed.
		 * If a table match is found within this script, set continueProcessing to false so no additional scope scripts are executed.
		 * If a scope table match is not found, then the single record will be added by the global checkTable function.
		 *
		 * If the table extends another table and you prefer to get all extensions, uncomment the default processParentTable = true and the if
		 * statement below it and set the table and function.
		 */
		
		var continueProcessing = true;
		var processParentTable = false;
		
		switch (tableName) {
			case "sn_cd_content_visibility":
				this._addScheduledContent(tableRec, tableName);
				continueProcessing = false;
				break;
			default:
				processParentTable = true;
				break;
		}

		if (processParentTable) {
			// Check for table needs at parent table level
			var tableBase = new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._getTableBase(tableName);
			switch (tableBase) {
				case "sn_cd_content_base":
					this._addContent(tableRec, tableName);
					continueProcessing = false;
					break;
			}
		}

		return continueProcessing;
	},
	
	_addScheduledContent: function(scheduleContent, tableName) {
		this._addToSet(scheduleContent);

		//Add audience records
		var audienceList = scheduleContent.audience.toString();
		if (!gs.nil(audienceList)) {
			this._addAudience(audienceList);
		}

		//Add portal content and dependencies
		this._addContent(scheduleContent.getValue("content"));

		if (scheduleContent.isValidField("forum_id") && !gs.nil(scheduleContent.getValue("forum_id"))) {
			new sn_communities.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addForum(scheduleContent.getValue("forum_id"));
		}
	},
	
	_addContent: function(contentRec, tableName) {
		var recID;
		if (typeof contentRec == "string") {
			recID = contentRec;
			contentRec = new GlideRecord("sn_cd_content_base");
			contentRec.get(recID);
		}
		recID = contentRec.getValue("sys_id");
		
		if (gs.nil(tableName)) {
			tableName = contentRec.getTableName();
		}
		if (tableName != contentRec.getValue("sys_class_name")) {
			contentRec = new GlideRecord(contentRec.getValue("sys_class_name"));
			contentRec.get(recID);
			tableName = contentRec.getTableName();
		}
		
		this._addToSet(contentRec);
		
		if (!gs.nil(contentRec.getValue("block"))) {
				var blockContent = contentRec.block.getRefRecord();
				this._addToSet(blockContent);
		}
		
		switch (tableName) {
			case "sn_cd_content_portal":
				if (!gs.nil(contentRec.getValue("url_asset"))) {
					this._addLinkContent(contentRec.getValue("url_asset"));
				}
				break;
			case "sn_cd_content_notification":
				//No references to other records
				break;
			case "sn_cd_content_mobile":
				if (!gs.nil(contentRec.getValue("url_link"))) {
					this._addLinkContent(contentRec.getValue("url_link"));
				}
				break;
			case "sn_cd_content_community":
				if (!gs.nil(contentRec.getValue("video_url_asset"))) {
					this._addLinkContent(contentRec.getValue("video_url_asset"));
				}
				if (!gs.nil(contentRec.getValue("virtual_url_asset"))) {
					this._addLinkContent(contentRec.getValue("virtual_url_asset"));
				}
				if (!gs.nil(contentRec.getValue("forum_links"))) {
					this._addLinkContent(contentRec.getValue("forum_links"));
				}
				break;
			case "sn_cd_content_todo":
				if (!gs.nil(contentRec.getValue("url_asset"))) {
					this._addLinkContent(contentRec.getValue("url_asset"));
				}
				//TODO: esig_template = sn_esign_configuration table in E-Signature scope
				break;
		}
	},
	
	_addLinkContent: function(linkList){
		var linkContent = new GlideRecord("sn_cd_url_asset");
		linkContent.addQuery("sys_id", "IN", linkList);
		linkContent.query();
		while (linkContent.next()) {
			this._addToSet(linkContent);

			if (linkContent.type == "forums_link") {
				new sn_communities.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addForum(linkContent.getValue("forum_id"));
			}
		}
	},
	
	// Helper function for other addToUpdateSetUtils to use
	_addContentFromList: function(contentList) {
		var contentRec = new GlideRecord("sn_cd_content_base");
		contentRec.addQuery("sys_id", "IN", contentList);
		contentRec.query();
		while (contentRec.next()) {
			this._addContent(contentRec, contentRec.getTableName());
		}
	},
	
	_addAudience: function(audienceList) {
		audienceList = audienceList.toString().split(",");
		for (var i = 0; i < audienceList.length; i++) {
			var audience = new GlideRecord("sn_cd_audience");
			if (audience.get(audienceList[i])) {
				this._addToSet(audience);
			}
		}
	},
	
	// Helper function for global.addToUpdateSetUtils() when adding a service portal page
	checkScheduledContent: function(spPageID) {
		var scheduleContent = new GlideRecord("sn_cd_content_visibility");
		scheduleContent.addQuery("sp_page", spPageID);
		scheduleContent.query();
		while (scheduleContent.next()) {
			this._addScheduledContent(scheduleContent);
		}
	},
	
	_addToSet: function(tableRec) {
		new global.addToUpdateSetUtils().saveRecord(tableRec);
	},

    type: 'addToUpdateSetUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2019-02-06 16:15:37</sys_created_on><sys_id>630e24904fef2b00d1676bd18110c778</sys_id><sys_mod_count>15</sys_mod_count><sys_name>addToUpdateSetUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Content Delivery" source="sn_cd">b26210490b7203008cd6e7ae37673a6a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Content Delivery">b26210490b7203008cd6e7ae37673a6a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_630e24904fef2b00d1676bd18110c778</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2020-03-11 20:18:47</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_ca.addToUpdateSetUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Version 3.1
Utility script to add components to update sets for content automation</description><name>addToUpdateSetUtils</name><script><![CDATA[var addToUpdateSetUtils = Class.create();
addToUpdateSetUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },
	
	checkTable: function(tableRec, tableName) {
		/*
		 * Scoped addToUpdateSetUtils Script Includes are useful when table Application Access settings prevent other scopes from CRUD access.
		 * The global checkTable function is executed first and if no table match is found, then all scope checkTable functions are executed.
		 * If a table match is found within this script, set continueProcessing to false so no additional scope scripts are executed.
		 * If a scope table match is not found, then the single record will be added by the global checkTable function.
		 *
		 * If the table extends another table and you prefer to get all extensions, uncomment the default processParentTable = true and the if
		 * statement below it and set the table and function.
		 */
		
		var continueProcessing = true;
		var processParentTable = false;
		
		switch (tableName) {
			case "sn_ca_campaign":
				this._addCampaign(tableRec, tableName);
				continueProcessing = false;
				break;
			case "sn_ca_campaign_bundle":
				var bundleQuery = "sys_id=" + tableRec.getValue("sys_id");
				this._addCampaignBundle(bundleQuery);
				continueProcessing = false;
				break;
			case "sn_ca_campaign_item":
				var contentQuery = "sys_id=" + tableRec.getValue("sys_id");
				this._addCampaignContent(contentQuery);
				continueProcessing = false;
				break;
			default:
				//processParentTable = true;
				break;
		}

		/*if (processParentTable) {
			// Check for table needs at parent table level
			var tableBase = new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._getTableBase(tableName);
			switch (tableBase) {
				case "table_name":
					this._function_name(tableRec, tableName);
					continueProcessing = false;
					break;
			}
		}*/

		return continueProcessing;
	},
	
	_addCampaign: function(campaign, tableName) {
		this._addToSet(campaign);

		//Add audience records
		var audienceList = campaign.audience.toString();
		if (!gs.nil(audienceList)) {
			this._addAudience(audienceList);
		}

		//Add campaign bundles
		var bundleQuery = "campaign=" + campaign.getValue("sys_id");
		this._addCampaignBundle(bundleQuery);
	},
	
	_addCampaignBundle: function(bundleQuery) {
		var bundleList = [];
		
		var campaignBundle = new GlideRecord("sn_ca_campaign_bundle");
		campaignBundle.addEncodedQuery(bundleQuery);
		campaignBundle.query();
		while (campaignBundle.next()) {
			this._addToSet(campaignBundle);
			bundleList.push(campaignBundle.getValue("sys_id"));
		}
		
		//Add campaign content
		var contentQuery = "campaign_bundleIN" + bundleList.toString();
		this._addCampaignContent(contentQuery);
	},
	
	_addCampaignContent: function(contentQuery) {
		var contentList = [];
		var audienceList = [];
		
		var campaignItem = new GlideRecord("sn_ca_campaign_item");
		campaignItem.addEncodedQuery(contentQuery);
		campaignItem.query();
		while (campaignItem.next()) {
			this._addToSet(campaignItem);
			
			//Collect audience records
			var audience = campaignItem.audience.toString().split(",");
			for (var i = 0; i < audience.length; i++) {
				if (!gs.nil(audience[i]) && audienceList.indexOf(audience[i]) == -1) {
					audienceList.push(audience[i]);
				}
			}
			
			contentList.push(campaignItem.getValue("content"));
		}
		
		//Add content
		this._addContent(contentList);
		
		//Add audience records
		this._addAudience(audienceList);
	},
	
	_addAudience: function(audienceList) {
		new sn_cd.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addAudience(audienceList);
	},
	
	_addContent: function(contentList) {
		new sn_cd.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addContentFromList(contentList);
	},
	
	// Helper function for global.addToUpdateSetUtils() when adding a service portal page
	checkScheduledContent: function(spPageID) {
		var scheduleContent = new GlideRecord("sn_cd_content_visibility");
		scheduleContent.addQuery("sp_page", spPageID);
		scheduleContent.query();
		while (scheduleContent.next()) {
			this._addScheduledContent("", "", scheduleContent);
		}
	},
	
	_addToSet: function(tableRec) {
		new global.addToUpdateSetUtils().saveRecord(tableRec);
	},

    type: 'addToUpdateSetUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2019-02-06 19:21:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>1da8d91c4f636b00d1676bd18110c735</sys_id><sys_mod_count>16</sys_mod_count><sys_name>addToUpdateSetUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Content Automation" source="sn_ca">bde72a4753710300d901a7e6a11c0838</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Content Automation">bde72a4753710300d901a7e6a11c0838</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_1da8d91c4f636b00d1676bd18110c735</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2020-03-11 20:17:55</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_hr_le.addToUpdateSetUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Version 3.0
Utility script to add components to update sets</description><name>addToUpdateSetUtils</name><script><![CDATA[var addToUpdateSetUtils = Class.create();
addToUpdateSetUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },
	
	checkTable: function(tableRec, tableName) {
		/*
		 * Scoped addToUpdateSetUtils Script Includes are useful when table Application Access settings prevent other scopes from CRUD access.
		 * The global checkTable function is executed first and if no table match is found, then all scope checkTable functions are executed.
		 * If a table match is found within this script, set continueProcessing to false so no additional scope scripts are executed.
		 * If a scope table match is not found, then the single record will be added by the global checkTable function.
		 *
		 * If the table extends another table and you prefer to get all extensions, uncomment the default processParentTable = true and the if
		 * statement below it and set the table and function.
		 */
		
		var continueProcessing = true;
		var processParentTable = false;
		
		switch (tableName) {
			case "sn_hr_le_type":
				this._addEventType(tableRec, tableName);
				continueProcessing = false;
				break;
			case "sn_hr_le_activity_set":
				this._addActivitySet(tableRec, tableName);
				continueProcessing = false;
				break;
			default:
				//processParentTable = true;
				break;
		}

		/*if (processParentTable) {
			// Check for table needs at parent table level
			var tableBase = new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._getTableBase(tableName);
			switch (tableBase) {
				case "table_name":
					this._function_name(tableRec, tableName);
					continueProcessing = false;
					break;
			}
		}*/

		return continueProcessing;
	},
	
	_addEventType: function(leType, tableName) {
		if (typeof leType == "string") {
			var recID = leType;
			leType = new GlideRecord("sn_hr_le_type");
			leType.get(recID);
		}
		this._addToSet(leType);
		this._addActivitySet(leType.getValue("sys_id"), leType.getTableName());
	},
	
	_addActivitySet: function(activitySet, tableName) {
		var activitySetList = [];
		if (typeof activitySet == "string") {
			var recID = activitySet;
			activitySet = new GlideRecord("sn_hr_le_activity_set");
			if (tableName == "sn_hr_le_activity_set") {
				activitySet.addQuery("sys_id", recID);
			} else {
				activitySet.addQuery("le_type", recID);
			}
			activitySet.query();
			while (activitySet.next()) {
				this._addToSet(activitySet);
				activitySetList.push(activitySet.sys_id.toString());
			}
		} else {
			this._addToSet(activitySet);
			activitySetList.push(activitySet.sys_id.toString());
		}
		
		var activity = new GlideRecord("sn_hr_le_activity");
		activity.addQuery("activity_set", "IN", activitySetList.toString());
		activity.query();
		while (activity.next()) {
			this._addToSet(activity);
			if (!gs.nil(activity.getValue("audience"))) {
				new sn_cd.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addAudience(activity.getValue("audience"));
			}
			if (!gs.nil(activity.getValue("badge"))) {
				new sn_hr_core.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addBadge(activity.getValue("badge"));
			}
			if (!gs.nil(activity.getValue("catalog_item"))) {
				this._addCatItem(activity.getValue("catalog_item"), activity.catalog_item.sys_class_name.toString());
			}
			if (!gs.nil(activity.getValue("email_template"))) {
				new sn_hr_core.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addEmailContent(activity.getValue("email_template"));
			}
			//ToDo add Flow flow, sys_hub_flow
			if (!gs.nil(activity.getValue("hr_criteria"))) {
				new sn_hr_core.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addHRCriteria("sys_id", activity.getValue("hr_criteria"));
			}
			if (!gs.nil(activity.getValue("hr_service"))) {
				new sn_hr_core.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addHRService(activity.getValue("hr_service"));
			}
			if (!gs.nil(activity.getValue("hr_template"))) {
				new sn_hr_core.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addHRTemplate(activity.getValue("hr_template"));
			}
			if (!gs.nil(activity.getValue("order_guide"))) {
				this._addCatItem(activity.getValue("order_guide"), activity.order_guide.sys_class_name.toString());
			}
			if (!gs.nil(activity.getValue("system_template"))) {
				new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addTemplate(activity.getValue("system_template"));
			}
			if (activity.isValidField("flow") && !gs.nil(activity.getValue("flow"))) {
				new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addFlow(activity.getValue("flow"));
			}
			
			var fieldMapping = new GlideRecord("sn_hr_le_activity_field_mapping");
			fieldMapping.addQuery("activity", activity.getValue("sys_id"));
			fieldMapping.query();
			while (fieldMapping.next()) {
				this._addToSet(fieldMapping);
			}
		}
	},
	
	_addCatItem: function(catItemID, tableName) {
		var catItem = new GlideRecord(tableName);
		if (catItem.get(catItemID)) {
			new global.addToUpdateSetUtils()._addCatItem(catItem, tableName);
		}
	},
	
	_addToSet: function(tableRec) {
		new global.addToUpdateSetUtils().saveRecord(tableRec);
	},

    type: 'addToUpdateSetUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2018-10-25 00:02:54</sys_created_on><sys_id>bc1a25ae4f55e740d1676bd18110c780</sys_id><sys_mod_count>27</sys_mod_count><sys_name>addToUpdateSetUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Human Resources: Lifecycle Events" source="sn_hr_le">532da270dad21200a4656ede91f9331e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Human Resources: Lifecycle Events">532da270dad21200a4656ede91f9331e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_bc1a25ae4f55e740d1676bd18110c780</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2019-10-18 14:48:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
